meta.name: programmatic-seo
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "build programmatic SEO pages" or "generate pages at scale"; designs a template × dataset page system with playbook selection, a data-defensibility tier check, and thin/duplicate guardrails. Not for finding what to target — use keyword-research or content-gap-analysis; not for writing one page — use seo-content-writer. 批量页面/程序化SEO/模板数据

copy.tagline: 批量生成程序化SEO页面，避免内容重复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用模板和数据批量生成大量SEO页面
copy.tagline_en: Generate programmatic SEO pages at scale with thin-content guardrails
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate many SEO pages from templates and data

howto.what: 它会帮你设计一套模板加数据集的系统，一次性生成成百上千个SEO页面。它会选择最合适的玩法、检查数据质量、设置防重复和内容过薄的规则，并输出完整的页面系统方案。
howto.when: 当你要求“批量生成SEO页面”或“大规模建页面”，或者需要规划程序化SEO页面系统、选择玩法、审计模板与数据集时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个城市×服务的程序化SEO页面方案，数据集有800个城市。
say.note: 它会设计模板、检查数据质量并标记内容过薄的风险。

say.text: 为我的产品对比页面选一个pSEO玩法，并定义模板字段。
say.note: 它会匹配最合适的玩法并设计模板结构。

say.text: 审计我现有的程序化页面，找出重复尾巴和内容过薄问题。
say.note: 它会扫描已发布页面，标记需要修复的问题。

howto.what_en: It designs a template × dataset system to generate hundreds or thousands of SEO pages at once. It selects the best playbook, checks data defensibility, sets thin/duplicate guardrails, and outputs a complete page-system plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "build programmatic SEO pages" or "generate pages at scale", or when you need to plan a pSEO page system, pick a playbook, or audit a template-x-data set for thin/duplicate risk.

say_en.text: Build a programmatic SEO plan for city×service pages from a dataset of 800 cities.
say_en.note: It will design the template, check data quality, and flag thin-content risk.

say_en.text: Pick the right pSEO playbook for my product comparison pages and define the template fields.
say_en.note: It will match the best playbook and design the template structure.

say_en.text: Audit my existing programmatic pages for duplicate tails and thin content.
say_en.note: It will scan published pages and flag issues to fix.
